summary: Enhance your database skills with our Oracle DBA Fundamentals Training Course. Learn essential concepts and techniques to manage Oracle databases effectively.
lede: Oracle database administration training covers the routine work of configuring, monitoring, securing, and recovering database environments. It is intended for junior DBAs, infrastructure administrators, and application support engineers who need to handle practical administration tasks. Learners practise instance and storage management, user and privilege controls, alert-log and SQL performance investigation, and RMAN backup and recovery, with introductory coverage of Data Guard, monitoring, and automation.
audienceIntro: This Oracle DBA course is designed for professionals who support, administer, troubleshoot, or govern Oracle Database environments and need a structured foundation before taking on deeper specialist responsibilities.
modules: Oracle Availability and Data Guard Concepts
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Basic systems administration or application support experience, familiarity with relational database concepts, and basic SQL reading ability. No programming background is required, although you will use SQL statements and simple administration scripts. Advanced topics such as Data Guard, ASM, AWR, and automation are taught at a conceptual and operational application level rather than at a production-engineering depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
